en: Black-and-white postcard image showing a historic two‑storey building with a steep tiled roof and a tall central clock tower topped by an onion-shaped dome and belfry. The facade has multiple rectangular windows and a doorway at street level. Above one central window on the first floor is the word "MUSEO". In front of the building stands a slender metal lattice structure with a small hut-like base. The cobblestone square around the building is visible. The upper left corner of the card bears the printed caption "Rauma."
